snippet.title: 【ENG】FATAL FURY: CotW｜Play Guide Trailer
snippet.description:
The brand-new fighting game FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves releases on 4/24/2025!
Official Site: https://www.snk-corp.co.jp/us/games/fatalfury-cotw/
 
■Available now for purchase or preorder!
[Digital Version Bonuses] (Ends 4/23/2025)
- DLC Costume "FATAL FURY 2 Terry"
- 3-Day Early Access (Playable from 4/21/2025)
[Physical Version Bonuses]
- DLC Costume "FATAL FURY 2 Terry"
 
■FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves Official Social Media
X (formerly Twitter): https://x.com/FATALFURY_PR
